SELECT group_name as group_name,group_id as id,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT belong_to) as cameraIds,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT model_name) as algorithmIds FROM `algorithm_manager` LEFT JOIN camera_group on algorithm_manager.group_id = camera_group.id
and group_id!=""
GROUP BY group_id

SELECT device_management.device_ip from (SELECT camera_manager.camera_ownership from camera_manager INNER JOIN camera_group_camera on camera_manager.id = camera_group_camera.camera_id
and camera_group_camera.group_id = #{id})
as temp INNER JOIN device_management on temp.camera_ownership = device_management.id GROUP BY device_management.device_ip
